title: Gravity On, Gravity Off
author: Claude
blurb: The same little place, twice. In level 1 you see it from the side and gravity pulls Rima down: she jumps a wall and walks off a ledge to fall. In level 2 you see it from above with gravity off, and Rima walks any of four ways and goes around the wall. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change one block's Gravity.

box.back: A small explorer in a teal beanie visits the same place twice. First from the side, where gravity pulls her down and a wall is something to jump. Then from above, where nothing pulls her and the arrow keys walk her every way. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and change the Gravity of a block.
features: Level 1 is a side-scroller with gravity; level 2 is the same scene from above with gravity off
Rima walks in four directions when nothing pulls her down
Made to be copied and taken apart
